remarks:
This expansive 6.2 acre flag lot offers exceptional privacy and versatility in a highly desirable West Seneca location.  The rectangular- shaped parcel features a flat terrain with a mixture of mature trees, brush and open space creating natural seclusion- perfect for building your dream home.

The flag lot configuration could provide a long driveway access that enhances privacy from the road while still delivering a generous, usable building envelope at the rear.

Utilities are available at the road, simplifying the path to construction.  Ideally situated with convenient access to major routes, shopping, schools and every day amenities.

This property can give you a country- like setting- without sacrificing location. It's 
 basically your blank canvas to do with what you want!
